title: Floor 3 Companion League remaining slices
description: Materialize the remaining implementation issues for Floor 3's Companion League epic from the living spec in .specify/specs/floor3-companion-league.md. Slices 1-6 and 8 have landed and slice 7 is already under review, so this graph starts at the remaining planned work to avoid duplicating existing PR work.

review.body: Source of truth: .specify/specs/floor3-companion-league.md and the linked Floor 3 game-design/roster documents. Human review should confirm this file still matches the remaining slice plan before closing as completed.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 9: Final Four arena chamber map generation
nodes.body: Complete the remaining Floor 3 set-piece work by adding the dedicated Final Four arena chamber generation path from the Floor 3 spec and validate it with the set-piece lab. The affinity-specific Studio motifs and Final Four set-piece definition are already authored and wired; prerequisite outside this epic file: slice 7 overworld/map work must be landed.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 10: persistent player reward track wiring
nodes.body: Wire Floor 3 defeated wild/trainer/Studio companions to the existing persistent player rewards path: XP gems, gold, loot, world.playerLevel, Inventory, and pickup helpers, with focused regression coverage.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 11: kept-companion persistence producer contract
nodes.body: Add the Floor 3 producer side of KeptCompanionContract on the floor-transition carryover channel and the end-of-floor picker hook. Floor 4+ consumption remains a separate epic concern.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 12: onboarding, starter, and poach UX surfaces
nodes.body: Implement the first Floor 3 UX group from the spec: intro/onboarding, starter choice, poach choice, and related deterministic UI/lab coverage using existing UI patterns.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 13: party HUD, roster, level-up, and combat command UX
nodes.body: Implement the second Floor 3 UX group from the spec: party HUD, roster/detail surfaces, level-up/evolution, ability command, and matchup indicator with deterministic coverage.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 14: versus intros, win/lose, overworld markers, and keep-companion UX
nodes.body: Implement the third Floor 3 UX group from the spec: versus intros, win/lose screens, overworld markers, and keep-companion picker, with deterministic visual/runtime checks.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 15: Companion League sprite generation
nodes.body: Generate and wire the 156 Companion form sprites for the Floor 3 roster through the approved sprite pipeline, preserving manifest integrity and floor art requirements.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 16: balance pass and win-rate gate
nodes.body: Run the Floor 3 balance and headless win-rate work from the spec, tuning against the required rate-based evidence without cherry-picking seeds. Broad sweeps must use GitHub infrastructure by default.
